items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: And then, if he get a job right now, a good job, he'll call for me. So, that's the night you should go and play with him a lot of times.

ctx.x: Oh, and music hits a family, it really hits a family, doesn't it?

That's right. When it hits a family, it really does hit it. And, uh, I mean, we didn't have any way of word about getting this one to play with us, about one to play because everybody just wanted to, uh, play. Not like Jeanette. Jeanette, sweetest she could be. You didn't have to beg her to come play a number on the piano. Or you have to say, Jeanette, do you feel like playing? Oh, she was right there ready. And at my house, well, on a Saturday, I mean on a Sunday evenings, we would have what you call, at my…
